title: ⭐️ Assistiti e componenti famiglia - Codice Fiscale
description: Nome, cognome e codice fiscale dell'assistito e dei componenti famiglia, per assistiti attivi e non attivi.
query:
-- ① ASSISTITO (capofamiglia)
SELECT
    c.id                        AS id,
    c.cod                       AS cod,
    CAST(c.number AS UNSIGNED)  AS number,
    c.active                    AS active,
    c.surname                   AS cognome,
    c.name                      AS nome,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_cf')) AS codice_fiscale,
    'Assistito'                 AS tipo

FROM customers c
INNER JOIN customers_mod_jobs j ON j.customer_id = c.id

UNION ALL

-- ② COMPONENTI FAMIGLIA
SELECT
    c.id                        AS id,
    c.cod                       AS cod,
    CAST(c.number AS UNSIGNED)  AS number,
    c.active                    AS active,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_cognome')
    )) AS cognome,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_nome')
    )) AS nome,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_cf')
    )) AS codice_fiscale,
    'Componente'                AS tipo

FROM customers c
INNER JOIN customers_mod_jobs j ON j.customer_id = c.id
JOIN (
    SELECT  0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT  1 UNION ALL SELECT  2 UNION ALL
    SELECT  3 UNION ALL SELECT  4 UNION ALL SELECT  5 UNION ALL
    SELECT  6 UNION ALL SELECT  7 UNION ALL SELECT  8 UNION ALL
    SELECT  9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL
    SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14
) n ON JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_cf')
       ) IS NOT NULL
   AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_cf')
       )) != ''

ORDER BY number ASC, tipo ASC, cognome ASC

title: ⭐️ Compimento 14 anni
description: Assistiti e componenti famiglia che compiono 14 anni nell'anno corrente (già compiuti o in attesa), per organizzare la firma della privacy.
query:
-- ① ASSISTITO (capofamiglia) che compie 14 anni nell'anno corrente
SELECT
    c.id                        AS id,
    c.cod                       AS cod,
    CAST(c.number AS UNSIGNED)  AS number,
    c.active                    AS active,
    c.surname                   AS cognome,
    c.name                      AS nome,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_birthday_data')) AS data_nascita,
    DATE_ADD(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_birthday_data')), INTERVAL 14 YEAR) AS compimento_data,
    CASE
        WHEN DATE_ADD(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_birthday_data')), INTERVAL 14 YEAR) <= CURDATE() THEN 'Compiuto'
        ELSE 'In attesa'
    END AS stato,
    ABS(DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_birthday_data')), INTERVAL 14 YEAR), CURDATE())) AS giorni,
    'Assistito'                 AS tipo

FROM customers c
INNER JOIN customers_mod_jobs j ON j.customer_id = c.id
WHERE JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_birthday_data') IS NOT NULL
  AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_birthday_data')) != ''
  AND YEAR(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`, '$.mod_jobs_anagrafica_birthday_data'))) = YEAR(CURDATE()) - 14

UNION ALL

-- ② COMPONENTI FAMIGLIA che compiono 14 anni nell'anno corrente
SELECT
    c.id                        AS id,
    c.cod                       AS cod,
    CAST(c.number AS UNSIGNED)  AS number,
    c.active                    AS active,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_cognome')
    )) AS cognome,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_nome')
    )) AS nome,
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_birthday_data')
    )) AS data_nascita,
    DATE_ADD(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_birthday_data')
    )), INTERVAL 14 YEAR) AS compimento_data,
    CASE
        WHEN DATE_ADD(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
            CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_birthday_data')
        )), INTERVAL 14 YEAR) <= CURDATE() THEN 'Compiuto'
        ELSE 'In attesa'
    END AS stato,
    ABS(DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_birthday_data')
    )), INTERVAL 14 YEAR), CURDATE())) AS giorni,
    'Componente'                AS tipo

FROM customers c
INNER JOIN customers_mod_jobs j ON j.customer_id = c.id
JOIN (
    SELECT  0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT  1 UNION ALL SELECT  2 UNION ALL
    SELECT  3 UNION ALL SELECT  4 UNION ALL SELECT  5 UNION ALL
    SELECT  6 UNION ALL SELECT  7 UNION ALL SELECT  8 UNION ALL
    SELECT  9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL
    SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14
) n ON JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_birthday_data')
       ) IS NOT NULL
   AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_birthday_data')
       )) != ''
WHERE YEAR(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.`values`,
        CONCAT('$.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp', IF(n.n = 0, '', CONCAT('_', n.n)), '.mod_jobs_famiglia_comp_birthday_data')
      ))) = YEAR(CURDATE()) - 14

ORDER BY compimento_data ASC, tipo ASC, cognome ASC

title: ⭐️ Assistiti attivi - Ultima spesa
description: Assistiti attivi con data dell'ultimo ordine, per individuare chi non fa la spesa da tempo.
query:
SELECT
    c.id                        AS id,
    c.cod                       AS cod,
    CAST(c.number AS UNSIGNED)  AS number,
    c.surname                   AS cognome,
    c.name                      AS nome,
    MAX(o.date)                 AS ultima_spesa,
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MAX(o.date)) AS giorni

FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.active = 1
GROUP BY c.id, c.cod, c.number, c.surname, c.name
ORDER BY ultima_spesa ASC
